First, is anyone hurt or in danger?

Thanks for letting me know. Next I need to confirm who you are.

What's your policy number? If you don't have it handy, you can give me your date of birth and mobile number instead.

Thanks, Tom, you're verified. I can see a 2022 Toyota RAV4, rego 789XYZ, on your policy.

In your own words, can you tell me what happened?
actually my neck's starting to hurt, and my passenger hit her head on the window

Tom, please call 000 now so you and your passenger can get checked, especially as she hit her head. The claim can wait.

I've passed a summary to a team member, and they're joining this chat now.
